title: GhostClaw Agent Registry
description: Validates the agent registry YAML that defines the agents available within the SIRINX OS GhostClaw system.

agents.description: List of registered agents and their operational permissions.

lane.description: Operational lane the agent belongs to, governing its role in the pipeline.

mutates_files.description: Whether the agent is permitted to create or modify files on disk.

tier_access.description: Tiers this agent is allowed to operate within.

owns.description: Glob patterns or resource names the agent is responsible for.

forbidden.description: Glob patterns or resource names the agent is explicitly forbidden from touching.

requires_lease.description: Whether the agent must acquire a lease before performing work.

requires_receipt.description: Whether the agent must produce a signed receipt after completing work.
